reviews.author: Jacob Phillips
reviews.text: I refer anyone and everyone to Harold's Tire! Robby has helped me out of good faith rather than out of a paycheck on multiple occasions. He takes pride in the business that Harold started many years ago. It's his legacy and with that, you know you're getting the best of the best in Tire and Auto Services. Robby is a man of his word. I have dealt with other tire and auto shops locally, one in specific did me wrong multiple times.....broke things and refused that they did it. I began looking for a different more reputable tire and auto shop and that's when I started dealing with Robby at Harold's Tire and needless to say he has my business for the long run. They keep many many of the most common tires in stock so MOST of the time you don't even have to wait for your tires to be ordered. May I add that their prices are on point! Give them a shot, you'll be glad you did and you'll find out why I refuse to go anywhere else! In fact I am headed to Harold's for a set of tires now!

reviews.author: Rian Lafayette
reviews.text: Called the day before to see if they could put tires on my trailer and was told to show up the next morning and they would fit me in. I got there at 8 and was done at 8:27. Pricing was super fair and the quality of service was awesome. It's nice to see a family run business doing it right. Now I know why my grandparents have been coming here since they can remember. Us younger generation need to start helping keep these type of places open. All the big names I called couldn't get me in or wanted me to take the tires off myself and charge me double what Harold did.

reviews.author: michael whitfield
reviews.text: Just bought the 2nd set of tires from Harold's for my truck. Harold is a good guy to do business with. Had an issue with the last set seemed to be a little bumpy at highway speeds. Rebalanced all four and found that it looks like a weight had come off of the LH Front. No issues now.

reviews.author: Monica Duffield
reviews.text: I have known the staff and owners for over 25 years ,they always go above and beyond to make people happy and service their car! Highly recommend this tire store in Easley!

reviews.author: Becca Price
reviews.text: If you're looking for southern charm and affordable tires, this is the place to go. Harold's had the best deal on new tires. The service for a tire change was quick and efficient. Their communication was amazing, and they have a real sense of community. I have a lot of respect for this establishment and I'm a lifelong customer after receiving such impeccable service.

reviews.author: Venida Holcombe
reviews.text: Harold's is a exactly why i support local businesses! Never had a bad experience here. Extra thankful for being worked in last min on a Saturday. These folks are always the best!

reviews.author: Angela Watson
reviews.text: Thank God for Robbie and all of his employees. They probably saved my life. Everyone kept telling me that my brakes were good but someone sold me the wrong rotors. Which almost made my brakes go out. I would give them 10 stars if I could.

reviews.author: Hannah Kirby
reviews.text: Fast service, budget friendly prices for a gal who needed a quick fix for a really bad tire. Aubri was sweet too on the phone and helping at the front desk. Caught my attention cuz my daughter has the same name.

reviews.author: Sierra Wood
reviews.text: Put a hole in my boyfriends tire and scratched his rims. Also forgot to put the tire cap back on. Very disappointed

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: We had two vehicles serviced/repaired this time. They didn't try to sell us a bunch of services or parts we didn't need, and let us know which services needed to be done now and which ones could be over time. Not many would do that- others would try to get every red cent they could. Super nice folks, friendly service, and reasonable prices. Small, locally owned and operated family business that treats all customers like friends and family. You don't stay in business for as long as they have and don't stay as busy as they do if you aren't good at what you do and good to the customers! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Zack Farmer
reviews.text: Walked in at 11am, asking if theyhad a set of 4 tires for my car. I was told my tires would be there at 2pm. Came back at 2pm and was out by 3 with a new set of 4 tires. They rotated them and even put on a missing lug nut for no extra charge. Top notch service! At an incredible price!

reviews.author: Dustin Kennon
reviews.text: They did a great job on my rear brakes last fall but I got impatient the next time I needed work done and went down the road because the other shop had faster availability, I’ve learned my lesson. The other shop couldn’t diagnose the issue and said nothing was wrong, about a week later I take it to Harold’s because I’m still hearing noises, especially when I hit the brakes. 10 minutes in the garage at Harold’s they had a diagnoses and had it all fixed up in 24 hours, never going anywhere else again.

reviews.author: Billy Coates
reviews.text: Very friendly service with reasonable prices Follow up. Great place to buy tires as well as other mechanical services. Had my front breaks redone and ended up replacing the rotors. Fair price and staff again was super friendly. Even took the time to talk a little Nascar.

reviews.author: Amanda “Mandi” Mulvey
reviews.text: First off, I want to start by saying I was stranded at a gas station for 2 hours, an hour from my home, waiting for roadside assistance to help change a tire (because I don't have a jack in my car). The owner of this shop stopped (only person to ask if I needed help including 3 sheriffs that had seen me sitting there with my trunk open and spare out). I told him I just needed a jack and he changed it for me. When I made a comment about needing tires, he told me about this shop. I stopped by to get a new one and he helped me with an amazing deal! The owner and staff were very knowledgeable, professional and courteous! I love an hour from this shop but will no longer take any of my 4 vehicles anywhere else! Thank you, Rob and staff!

reviews.author: Poppa Wheelies
reviews.text: Incredibly-honest. Won’t rip you off like most places. If you’re convinced your vehicle needs something & it turns-out not to be the case, they will say-so instead of taking advantage & lining their pockets. This also goes for women & the elderly who are especially vulnerable. Have been using Harold’s Tire for nearly 30 years. Reliable, competent, courteous & punctual. They do what they say when they say. If your vehicle needs to be left overnight they lock it inside & the place of-course has an alarm. The owner Robbie is a great guy & Brad especially knows his business. I wouldn’t let anyone else touch my truck including the Toyota dealership. I’ve made a point instructing my 93 year-old grandmother never to allow anyone else touching her car. This place is truly a diamond in-the-ruff & I feel lucky to have them as my go-to shop.

reviews.author: Jacobie Frasier
reviews.text: Great customer service. However they are very slow for an auto shop. If your looking for fast pace with front alignments you won’t get it here

reviews.author: Rita Seaborn
reviews.text: I bought my very first set of tires from Harold's Tire in 1975 and have been depending on ahar9lds ever since. Robbie, the owner, honest, knowledgeable, and dependable, as is his staff of mechanics. The staff is awesome. You can't miss with Harold's Tire!!

reviews.author: Jamie Richards
reviews.text: Harold’s put some tires on my work truck and only had two in stock. I needed 6 tires and an hour later they had all six tires and complete my service. Since then I’ve been to Harold’s 4 times with different trucks and have two more appointments for my last two trucks to get serviced. These guys are reasonable and do great work. Thanks guys!!!!

reviews.author: Mario Springer
reviews.text: ONLY ONEWAY TO PUT IT IS GO SOMEWHERE ELSE, ANYWHERE ELSE BUT Harold's tire...I HAD THEM PUT A SET OF TIRES ON MY CAR TODAY...MARCH 15 2024 AND THEY DAMAGED EVERYONE OF MY WHEELS ALL THE WAY AROUND THE RIMS EDGE PUTTING THE TIRES ON AND TOLD ME IT WAS LIKE THAT...MY WHEELS DID HAVE SOME LIGHT SCUFFS,BUT NOT WHAT THEY LOOK LIKE NOW....LUCKY FOR ME WE HAVE PICTURES MY SON TOOK ABOUT A WEEK OR TWO AGO TO SHOW THEY WASN'T... (GOING TO COURT)...ALSO THE WORKERS AT LESS THE TWO THAT WAS THERE TODAY ARE MOST DEFINITELY ON DOPE....SO BEWARE AND GO SOMEWHERE ELSE..WISH I COULD GIVE NO STARS AND I WILL POST PICTURES TOMORROW...BETTER OFF GOING TO DISCOUNT TIRE,CAROLINA TIRE,GOODYEAR TIRE OR ROOTS IN EASLEY

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.text: These people are awesome! I brought my mower tire in to have it repaired and I was out of there within minutes. Everyone I interacted with was very personable and nice. I highly recommend Harolds and look forward to doing business with them in the future.

reviews.author: Brian R
reviews.text: I can't brag on this place enough. I've had 2 experiences where I've had something in a tire that I've had to get patched. Other places tried to tell me the tire could not be repaired, but these guys fixed them no problem. It really says a lot in today's world when a business actually does honest work. One of the issues they even told me they could not guarantee it would work but the tire still lasted an additional 2 years after they repaired it until it was completely bald and needed replaced. If you're in the upstate I recommend going to them any time you have a tire issue

reviews.author: Nina Owens
reviews.text: I am new to Easley and thought I'd give Harold's a try after reading the good reviews. Honestly, I wasn't expecting the actual experience to live up to the hype of the loyal local clients. I'm excited to say that I was proved wrong! Not only did I get a great deal on my tires, but they actually saved me money. I did feel that they were very honest, even going as far to show me the good condition of my brakes when I offered for them to be changed. They showed me my brake pad up close and a new pad, to compare and explained that mine were still in good shape. I feel that a more dishonest place would have done the job (or not) and charged me anyway. I really appreciated this gesture. Also, they were on time for my appointment and got me out of there fast. From now on I will be reccomending Harold's to my friends and family , and I will be bringing my car back!

reviews.author: Graham
reviews.text: Could not say enough kind things about these people. They're kind, honest, fair, and cheap, and they know their way around a car. All you could ask for in mechanic. Haven't met a person that works here who isn't competent and courteous. I recommend Harold's all the time to and so does my mom.

reviews.author: Bob Fetterly
reviews.text: We've had very good service from Harold's with two cars now. No wonder our normal mechanic recommended him when they were too busy.

reviews.author: Natasha Arnold
reviews.text: My dad told me about this place and I've been to them twice for different things and both times I was treated with much respect and hospitality. They are also cheaper than other places I called. I definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Cindy McNutt
reviews.text: The guys (and girls) here are so nice. They do an excellent job, with speedy service and great prices!

reviews.author: Margaret Birch
reviews.text: I couldn't of had a better car experience. Harold's tire explained everything that I needed to know. My alignment was off on all tires and it caused the inner tires to go bald . We just got the car and didn't know much about it so we had them check it out and he managed to work me in that same day because he said the tire could go at any minute do I had them do it and they even worked late to finish it..and the ladies at the desk were very friendly and informative I will definitely be going back.

reviews.author: Cierra Martinez
reviews.text: Have been taking my vehicles to Harold’s for almost a decade, and I highly recommend! Great people! Rob, and all the other employees are extremely helpful and personable.

reviews.author: KIM BROWN
reviews.text: Took my 04 Toyota Avalon that I purchased in 2019 to Harold's Tire to have my AC checked. They checked freon gave me a call asked what I was having issues with. I told her it wasn't cooling very good. They checked the filter only to find an old chipmunk nest that had been there a while from looks of it. Replaced filter and now my AC freezes me to death. No pressure to purchase anything else. Was informed I would need a timing belt which I already knew about. Thanks so much for the great service I will be back for that timing belt.

reviews.author: Mike Aiken
reviews.text: The owner and staff are honest and trustworthy. You can trust that they are telling you the truth and they don't try to sell you things that are unnecessary like many shops do. I've done business with them for years and would strongly recommend them to anyone looking for an honest and reliable shop.

reviews.author: Gigi Henley
reviews.text: Used this place about 2 weeks ago for a used tire we couldn't find ANYWHERE else, had excellent service, had to get a new tire that I expected to be quite expensive (low profile, high speed rating) and they got me a new one for less than $100 out the door and got it to their store within 4 hours for me! Super nice group of employees, highly recommend them for service and tire needs!

reviews.author: Phil McCollum
reviews.text: Robbie and his team are my go to favorite for tires and car service. You can always count on him for honesty and standing behind their service and he is always conscious of trying to save me money and providing value.

reviews.author: Tamara Boysworth
reviews.text: They left my car unlocked over night and someone went rummaging through my trunk and took a few things. They did okay work but use a name bring of tire that I've never heard of. It also sounds like a restaurant "chilis". The service was okay but the workers would not meet my eyes as they talked to me. Especially not when I said someone had dented my door and scratched it in their parking lot.

reviews.author: Marie Smith
reviews.text: Very disappointed. Personal was rough looking. First call was answered by a child and we were told wrong. Stopped by and they actually had the tire we needed. My husband had to put the tire on him self while employee stood by and watched. I have never been so shocked at how far down this place has gone. We won't be back.

reviews.author: Stephen Gee
reviews.text: This place was awesome! We are from Georgia and we was stranded in this town on a sunday. We had to stay the night and a person recommended us to harolds. Our tire is impossible to find but they had something that would work. They was so helpful and kind. I would recommend this place to everyone!

reviews.author: Amy Robinson
reviews.text: We have used Harold's several times and we typically had good service from them until the last visit. We had to repair a brand new lawn mower tire. We opted to have a tube installed rather than patch it which cost about $40. They repaired it but they damaged the metal rim on the tire. We put the tire back on so I could mow the lawn and I did not make it very far before my tire was completely flat. The damaged rim had sliced open the tube we just had them install. We had to pay an additional $20 for that repair and we still have a bent rim. I am honestly really disappointed.

reviews.author: Zack Farmer
reviews.text: I've only dealt with them once in fairness to this review but when I went the staff was very friendly, seen me quickly but the pricing was just average I had to get a tire for my kia rio and they were about the same price as everywhere else.

reviews.author: Vitaliy D
reviews.text: Got there and ordered tires for my car because they didn't have the tires for my car and she promised to call me by 4pm when tires get delivered..., thru this day I didn't hear from them if my tires ever arrived or not.... I do not recommend this shop watched some of ppls work there looks like they don't know what they doing I'm mechanic and know what I'm saying.

reviews.author: Kevin M
reviews.text: I had a young latino gentleman whose truck broke down in front of my mom's house. Tire was as flat as a pancake. There was an adventure to get the tire off of the truck as he had no lug wrench or jack. I had my bottle jack which was not tall enough because of his after market wheels. I went to my house got my floor jack and we changed the tire and went to Harold's. The front desk staff indicated a half hour wait. Robbie asked me what was needed and I explained the situation. Robbie took the young man and pretty much waited on him himself. Thank you Robbie. That guy was from out of town and was impressed by your service as was I!!

reviews.author: Jenifer Williams
reviews.text: I absolutely love this garage. Always prompt with their work and always a great job. Great group of gals working the front also.

reviews.author: Cari Chamberlin
reviews.text: This shop is staffed with the absolute BEST team around! Honest, reliable, and ALWAYS going that extra mile to make sure their customers are taken care of.

reviews.author: Laine Lemon
reviews.text: Harold's is reasonably priced and always does a good job of taking care of his customers. He is one of the most honest people you will find.

reviews.author: Mike Parker
reviews.text: Harolds Tire is a very honest and very reasonably priced business that performs great work! They do all of our work and we appreciate them greatly! -Mike Parker @ Cochran Landscape Mgt

reviews.author: Gary Street
reviews.text: My Father In Law used Harold's Tire all thru the 50's &70's. He told me about them in 1976 and they have always been great to work with. Honest and Fair.

reviews.author: J Leard
reviews.text: I sat in hard rocker for 2 hours and my truck was still not touched. No one said a word. And i called ahead of time amd was told to come 30 min early. Just to sit 2 hours fir nothing.

reviews.author: Vincent Bearden
reviews.text: Always get tires there and never had any problems out of them. They have done brakes and front end alinement. Great service.

reviews.author: Brett Looper
reviews.text: I build my classic cars and repair my daily drivers in my own shop. I rely on a tire shop for a tire machine and a alignment machine. You will not find a better place to take care of your automotive needs in Easley. His prices can't be beat. He is competitive with internet prices on tires. I have compared and discussed prices with the owner. I know a lot about cars since I build them. I only trust two tire shops in Easley and this is one of them.

reviews.author: I'm Urredness Katie Speezak
reviews.text: Great bunch of gentlemen that are sweet & extremely helpful. Prices are reasonably low as well. Will tell anyone to go to them for ur car needs.

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.text: The best in Easley honest and trust worthy my husband doesn't let anyone else touch our vehicle. It is a Christian and family owned business.

reviews.author: Jinx
reviews.text: Very fast Very friendly and Very affordable. I would definitely recommend. I was in and out within 10 minutes max. I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Sabina Martinez
reviews.text: They were very friendly....very professional and their prices were great for 4 new tires... I will definitely be returning to Harold's Tire & Auto!!!

reviews.author: Susan Hafner
reviews.text: It was great, fixed my problem in a timely manner. Great people and would keep doing business with them. Very efficient and professional.

reviews.author: Douglas M Pacheco
reviews.text: Family owned and operated , very honest and trustworthy. They are one of the oldest shops in the area, even their competition says they are great.

reviews.author: Allison Williams
reviews.text: Very helpful and the staff is great... You are not over charged for the service you need either.. Great place for car care needs

reviews.author: harley deal
reviews.text: If you need tires these are the people to come to. Great prices, fair and honest to deal with. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joshua Ibebunjo
reviews.text: Great service!!! The owner is extremely honest, fair, and fast. In my opinion the BEST mechanic around.

reviews.author: Ben Nabors
reviews.text: These folks are honest, down to earth people who will be fair in their pricing and fast with service. It is truly a family business.

reviews.author: Tyeann Reece
reviews.text: Very trust worthy staff. I have been a customer of theirs for years and they are very reliable and quick to get you what you need.

reviews.author: Kevin Robinson
reviews.text: Fast, friendly service. I've been going there for over 20 years and I'm completely satisfied with their work

reviews.author: John Rabon
reviews.text: Always a good experience. Haven't found anyone else like them. They find problems others overlooked and go the extra mile.

reviews.author: Jason Hucker
reviews.text: Honest mechanics at a fair price the family has been taking our cars there for years Rob and his staff our top notch!

reviews.author: Ronnie Glass
reviews.text: Very kind and courteous folks, excellent workmanship and prices for repairs that you will definitely appreciate!

reviews.author: JOSEPH BRITT
reviews.text: As usual Harold's was great and affordable. The service was excellent and it was a very friendly environment.

reviews.author: Lynda Henry
reviews.text: The staff is very friendly, politeand won't try to rip you off. Plus they will work with your budget

reviews.author: Tyler Blitz
reviews.text: Scratches wheels. Do not take brand new wheels that you care about bc they will be scratched. He will not pay for the damage caused. Worst place to go

reviews.author: Joey
reviews.text: Quick, solid service at a reasonable price. Great team, very knowledgeable, and very willing to help

reviews.author: Rhonda Davis
reviews.text: Great people and great prices on the jobs they do. I would recommend anytime to go see them for any auto work

reviews.author: Cindy Weir
reviews.text: I had a tire problem and they helped me immediately. Very friendly staff and I will return for future service.

reviews.author: Michael Boyd
reviews.text: Respect their total honesty, and giving advice to find a solution of a bigger problem with my truck.

reviews.author: Angela Thompson
reviews.text: My daddy would hang out here when I was a kid. They r a friendly place. I needed car tires no1 had they found. At

reviews.author: Michael Rhoads
reviews.text: Rob has always taken care of my tire, wheel, brake and alignment needs. I trust him with my cars and my kids cars.
